svg.title: How archvfinds works
svg.desc: A catalog of brand hubs, category hubs, outfits and QC photos feeds the archvfinds site. Shoppers pick a buying agent once and every product link opens in that agent. A Discord bot posts a curated find, a poll and a QC pick each week, and first-party analytics count visitors with a daily-rotating hash.
svg.text: Mon curated find, Thu poll, Sat QC pick
Salted visitor hash, rotated daily, no IPs
